column2: Alone, with the mod and its additions, no server and no guests. Pick the save to load.
No save marked Solo to load. Solo Coop does not create a new game: on the Saves page, mark a save Solo or import one.
This save no longer exists: pick another one.
SOLO: the game without the mod, as its developer made it. SOLO COOP: alone, with the mod and its additions, on the save of your choice.
Pick your game (MSC or MWC, top left), your nickname, then HOST, JOIN, SOLO or SOLO COOP. That's it!

PLAY — Home: your nickname, the network (Steam or IP), HOST, JOIN, SOLO, SOLO COOP. Lobby: the players, the session code, the options, the chat, READY and START. Saves: your games, one per group of friends.
\"Main game\" is the game's normal save: SOLO always keeps it. The game's folder is shown at the bottom (Open).

SOLO COOP: on click, pick among the saves marked Solo, then Launch: the launcher checks the save (it only shows the result if there is a problem, and you choose whether to launch), makes a backup copy, and the game loads it. Cancel launches nothing. No new game is created.
Two buttons on Home: SOLO, the game without the mod; SOLO COOP, alone with the mod and its additions, on the save of your choice.
